_meta.description: Curated human PK reference data for 100 marketed drugs — used for PBPK model validation. Span: 8 CYP families, P-gp/BCRP/OATP substrates, MW 136-1202, fu 0.001-1.0, F_oral 0.05-1.0.
_meta.expanded: 2026-06-03: 30 → 100 drugs (FDA label-derived PK; FDA clinical pharmacology reviews public)

drugs.name: Simvastatin
drugs.cmax_note: lactone prodrug — reference Cmax is for parent lactone; acid form (active) has different distribution; Vd corrected to 2193 L (= CL_apparent × t½ / 0.693)

drugs.name: Fluoxetine
drugs.reference: DrugBank DB00472; single-dose Cmax 7-10 ng/mL (Bergstrom 1988 JPsychRes)
drugs.cmax_note: single-dose Cmax used (0.008 µg/mL); steady-state Cmax ~0.015 µg/mL due to long t½=48h

drugs.name: Clopidogrel
drugs.exclusion_reason: Prodrug: parent compound undergoes rapid CYP2C19-mediated ester hydrolysis and thiol activation. Measured CL_apparent=8333 L/h (CL_true=4167 L/h) reflects metabolic conversion flux, not distributional clearance. Hepatic blood flow ~90 L/h (Davies & Morris, Pharm Res 1993); a 46-fold excess is physiologically impossible for a 1-compartment model. Validated by: Sanofi-Aventis USPI 2011; Kazui et al. Drug Metab Dispos 2010.

drugs.name: Fentanyl
drugs.cmax_note: IV bolus Cmax is injection-rate-dependent; 1-compartment model with terminal Vd underestimates Cmax (Vc ~13L vs Vd_ss=335L); known structural model limitation for bolus IV drugs
